description: This file defines a PerformanceTracker class that is responsible for tracking application performance metrics using Firebase Performance Monitoring.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: A singleton class for tracking performance metrics using Firebase Performance Monitoring.

methods.name: startTrace
methods.description: Starts a new performance trace with the given trace name.

methods.name: measureAsync
methods.description: Measures the duration of a suspend block, starting and stopping a trace.

methods.name: incrementCounter
methods.description: Increments a counter for a trace by 1.

methods.name: putMetric
methods.description: Records a metric for a trace with a specified name and value.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a trace with a specified name and value.
